title: Snapshots
empty: No snapshots yet — tweak the settings above and save one.
exportFailed: Export failed — the browser blocked the download.
importUnreadable: Import failed — the file could not be read.
importEmpty: No valid snapshots found in the file ({skipped} skipped).
saveFailed: Saving failed — storage is full or blocked. Snapshots saved this session will be lost on reload.
restoreReset: Speeds absent from the snapshot were reset to the preset defaults ({fields}).
restoreUnresolvedPreset: Preset “{preset}” is unavailable — current hardware kept.
